recaps.title: Breaking
recaps.intro: The Supreme Court turned away the Trump administration's bid to sideline about 20,000 California mail ballots, hours before polls open nationwide.
recaps.label: From posts on X

bullets.text: The Supreme Court rejects the Trump administration's push for California to set aside about 20,000 disputed mail ballots ahead of the midterms
bullets.note: The court turned down the emergency request hours after it was filed, on the eve of Election Day, CNN reports

recaps.title: Evening wrap
recaps.intro: Trump made his closing pitch at the Reflecting Pool as polls showed him near a record low and the courts handed his administration setbacks, while abroad Russia struck a Ukrainian school and the Houthis pushed toward Aden.
recaps.label: From posts on X

bullets.text: Trump delivers his final pre-election speech at the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool and repeats his promise of 5,000 dollar checks if Republicans win
bullets.note: He called Tuesday the most important midterm in our lifetime, CBS reports

bullets.text: Trump's approval rating holds near a record low as many voters see the midterms as a way to oppose him, a Reuters/Ipsos poll finds
bullets.note: Sets the mood a day before polls open

bullets.text: Cook Political Report now rates Democrat Abdul El-Sayed favored to win Michigan's Senate race
bullets.note: The shift makes Democrats more likely to win a Senate majority than Republicans to keep it, the Post says

bullets.text: The Justice Department plans to send a record number of election monitors to polling places in all 50 states on Tuesday
bullets.note: A larger federal presence at the polls than ever before

bullets.text: A US judge dismisses the Trump administration's case over its Harvard admissions probe
bullets.note: Comes the same day the Supreme Court turned down the California ballot request

bullets.text: Virginia and the District of Columbia sue in federal court to stop construction of the triumphal arch planned for Memorial Circle in Washington
bullets.note: A last-ditch legal effort against the project

bullets.text: The NTSB says the Learjet that crashed onto a Florida roadway Sunday, killing all nine aboard, may have been breaking up before it hit the ground
bullets.note: An early clue in the investigation of the Palm Beach County crash

bullets.text: Florida faces a potentially historic amount of rainfall as a flash flood warning continues
bullets.note: Flooding risk stays high in the state tonight

bullets.text: Zelensky says Russian strikes hit a school where aid was being distributed in southeastern Ukraine
bullets.note: He says the attack dashed hopes of progress toward peace after the local ceasefire ended

bullets.text: Yemen's Houthis advance to within 80 km of Aden, sources tell Reuters
bullets.note: A major advance in Yemen's war toward the southern port city

bullets.text: Snap settles a social media addiction lawsuit before it was set to go to trial this month
bullets.note: The plaintiffs had already settled with Meta, TikTok and YouTube, NBC News reports

bullets.text: The New York Times sues the maker of the Brave web browser over copyrights
bullets.note: A copyright fight between a major newspaper and a browser maker

bullets.text: After 28 years, Karl Bushby finishes his walk around the world, arriving home in Hull, England, after 31,000 miles
bullets.note: He set out from Chile in 1998 and crossed 30 countries on foot

recaps.title: Culture & entertainment
recaps.intro: Bruce Springsteen jumped into Michigan's Senate race, Justin Timberlake set a tell-all docuseries and Johnny Depp opened the door to one more Pirates film.
recaps.label: From posts on X

bullets.text: Bruce Springsteen endorses Democrat Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan's Senate race on the eve of Election Day
bullets.note: The Boss weighs in after Rep. Haley Stevens backed the Republican

bullets.text: Justin Timberlake will release a four-part tell-all docuseries on Apple TV in December
bullets.note: A source says Janet Jackson discusses the 2004 Super Bowl wardrobe malfunction

bullets.text: Johnny Depp says he would return as Jack Sparrow in Pirates of the Caribbean 6 to send the franchise off on a better note
bullets.note: He says it depends on how the franchise is wrapped up

bullets.text: Neve Campbell says she will be in Scream 8, which is still in development
bullets.note: Sidney Prescott is coming back

bullets.text: Matthew Wright, a longtime executive producer of The Ellen DeGeneres Show, dies at 52
bullets.note: Ellen DeGeneres paid tribute in an emotional video

bullets.text: HBO renews Sharon Horgan's comedy Youth for a second season
bullets.note: The news came less than 24 hours after the season one finale

bullets.text: Tate McRae's Housewife spends a second week at No. 1 on the Billboard Global charts
bullets.note: A strong run for the pop single

bullets.text: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping will play in 3D in theaters and on Meta's new VR glasses
bullets.note: A new way to watch the next Hunger Games film

bullets.text: Mckenna Grace says she turns down roles with nudity because her dream is to play a Disney princess someday
bullets.note: The Scream star spoke to Cosmopolitan

recaps.title: Science & space
recaps.intro: NASA's Swift telescope is due to fall back to Earth on Wednesday as China laid out its Moon landing timeline and the space station readied a final solar array spacewalk.
recaps.label: From posts on X

bullets.text: NASA's Swift telescope will likely fall back to Earth on Wednesday, with the risk of harm to anyone put at about 1 in 2,100
bullets.note: Most of it should burn up after 22 years spotting gamma-ray bursts and exploding stars

bullets.text: China lays out its plan to land astronauts on the Moon before 2030, with test flights starting in early 2027
bullets.note: The most detailed public timeline yet in the race with NASA, Ars Technica reports

bullets.text: Astronauts Joshua Kutryk and Anil Menon will spacewalk Thursday to install the space station's eighth and final roll-out solar array
bullets.note: Completes the upgrade to the station's power system

bullets.text: Red blood cells preserved in 3D detail are found in a dinosaur leg bone from Brazil
bullets.note: Rare soft-tissue evidence from an Aratasaurus fossil

bullets.text: The FDA approves a low-cost version of the twice-yearly HIV prevention shot
bullets.note: Brings the breakthrough drug closer to market in low-income countries

bullets.text: November skies bring several meteor shower peaks, Jupiter meeting Mars before dawn and a supermoon, NASA says
bullets.note: A good month to look up

bullets.text: Hubble finds nearby dwarf galaxies are missing much of the oxygen researchers expected
bullets.note: Supernova winds appear to strip oxygen better than models predict

bullets.text: Scientists convert a handful of smells into electronic signals that can be sent over the internet
bullets.note: An early step toward sharing scent digitally

bullets.text: A 2018 landslide that dammed a river in Canada's Mackenzie Valley was a new type, a permafrost detachment slide, researchers say
bullets.note: The slide created a lake 3.5 kilometers long

bullets.text: Madagascar's big flying foxes have shrunk over the past 150 years, possibly due to selective hunting
bullets.note: A sign of human pressure on wildlife

bullets.text: Rocket Lab launches its Electron rocket with the QPS-SAR-20 satellite from New Zealand, one short of its 100th launch
bullets.note: The small launcher nears a major milestone

recaps.title: Pictures of the day
recaps.intro: A spacewalker and a dwarf galaxy from NASA, scenes of war damage in Lebanon and Ukraine, and a homecoming after a 28-year walk.
recaps.label: From posts on X

bullets.text: NASA astronaut Anil Menon floats outside the International Space Station during the Oct. 29 spacewalk
bullets.note: Close-up scenes from orbit ahead of Thursday's spacewalk.

bullets.text: Hubble's view of a clumpy, glittering dwarf galaxy studied for its missing oxygen
bullets.note: A deep-space portrait full of young stars.

bullets.text: Dust rises over a town in southern Lebanon where Israel's military has kept blowing up homes, a Lebanese news agency says
bullets.note: A stark view of the damage in Zawtar al-Sharqiyah.

bullets.text: Rescuers search the dark ruins of a school hit by a Russian strike in southeastern Ukraine
bullets.note: The strike hit as aid was being handed out.

bullets.text: A crowd with phones raised greets adventurer Karl Bushby as he arrives home in Hull after 28 years on foot
bullets.note: The end of a 31,000-mile walk from Chile.

recaps.title: Market close
recaps.intro: Tech sold off again as chipmakers pushed the Nasdaq 100 into a correction, while the Dow edged higher and oil plunged more than 7% on US-Iran peace talk hopes. Apple and Palantir beat estimates after the bell.
recaps.label: From posts on X

bullets.text: The Nasdaq fell about 1% and the S&P 500 lost 0.51%, giving up early gains, while the Dow rose about 0.4%
bullets.note: Investors kept moving out of tech; Sherwin-Williams rose almost 6% and Home Depot 3.6%, powering the Dow, per CNBC.

bullets.text: A selloff in chipmakers pushed the Nasdaq 100 down 10% from its October peak, into a technical correction
bullets.note: Extends the pullback in AI-linked stocks that left the Nasdaq with a losing October.

bullets.text: Marvell agreed to buy optical-parts maker Lumentum in an all-stock deal valued at 115 billion dollars
bullets.note: Marvell shares dropped almost 13% and Lumentum fell 18% after the announcement, per CNBC.

bullets.text: Oracle filed to sell 10 billion dollars of new stock and 10 billion dollars of bonds to pay for its AI build-out
bullets.note: Oracle shares declined 8% on the day, per CNBC.

bullets.text: US crude futures fell 7.36% to settle at 96.46 dollars a barrel; Brent dropped 7.63% to 104.77 dollars
bullets.note: Prices fell on hopes the US and Iran may resume peace talks, per CNBC.

bullets.text: Treasury yields fell to their lowest since Sept. 10; the 10-year yield was down 5.76 basis points at 4.871% in the afternoon
bullets.note: Tumbling oil prices eased concern about inflation pressure leading to more Fed rate hikes, per Bloomberg.

bullets.text: After the bell, Apple reported quarterly revenue of 114.48 billion dollars and EPS of 2.10 dollars, both above estimates
bullets.note: iPhone revenue of 57.58 billion dollars beat estimates, while Greater China revenue of 17.54 billion dollars fell short.

bullets.text: Palantir posted third-quarter revenue of 2.31 billion dollars and adjusted EPS of 44 cents, above estimates
bullets.note: It raised its full-year revenue forecast to 8.53 billion dollars and sees fourth-quarter revenue of 2.65 billion dollars.

bullets.text: ON Semiconductor reported third-quarter revenue of 1.72 billion dollars and adjusted EPS of 90 cents, above estimates
bullets.note: The chipmaker sees fourth-quarter revenue of 1.72 billion to 1.82 billion dollars.

recaps.title: Politics & Washington
recaps.intro: On the eve of the midterms, the Trump administration took its California ballot fight to the Supreme Court and a judge threw out the case against two former FBI officials.
recaps.label: From posts on X

bullets.text: The Trump administration asks the Supreme Court to make California set aside about 20,000 mail ballots it says may be from noncitizens
bullets.note: The emergency request lands one day before Election Day

bullets.text: A federal magistrate judge dismisses the false statements case against two former FBI officials accused of lying to Congress about Hunter Biden
bullets.note: NBC News calls it yet another loss for Trump's Justice Department

bullets.text: Trump vows to protect Elon Musk and floats pre-emptive pardons for his staff
bullets.note: Axios reports Trump raised the idea of pardons before any charges are brought

bullets.text: Trump says he wants to seek a third term but acknowledges the law probably precludes it
bullets.note: He made the remarks in a New York Post podcast interview on the eve of the midterms

bullets.text: A new NBC News poll finds Democrats with a sizable advantage in the battle for control of Congress
bullets.note: NBC says key groups that boosted Trump in 2024 are shifting toward Democrats

bullets.text: Sen. Tim Scott declines to say whether he would accept the Alaska Senate result if Democrat Mary Peltola wins
bullets.note: The Alaska race has drawn fights over ballots and certification

bullets.text: Mamdani threatens to sue the Trump administration over ICE use of New York City parking lots
bullets.note: He calls the move illegal commandeering

bullets.text: The IRS sent a mass email praising Trump's tax cuts, similar to one the Social Security Administration sent in October
bullets.note: Agency messages touting the president's policies arrive just before the midterms

bullets.text: Political ad spending this cycle is projected to reach a record 11.6 billion dollars by the time polls close
bullets.note: The figure comes from ad-tracking firm AdImpact, making 2026 the most expensive US election cycle

bullets.text: Voters in 39 states will decide ballot measures on election laws, transgender rights, taxes and abortion
bullets.note: State measures can change policy directly, regardless of who wins Congress

bullets.text: California Gov. Gavin Newsom proposes a 1 billion dollar film and TV tax credit
bullets.note: The proposal targets California's film and TV industry

recaps.title: World
recaps.intro: Iran talks in Qatar ended without a breakthrough as Trump weighed renewed war, while fighting resumed in Kherson and a cyberattack hit grocery stores across Europe.
recaps.label: From posts on X

bullets.text: Iran says contacts over ending the war continue after talks in Qatar ended with no breakthrough
bullets.note: Qatar is facilitating indirect talks between Iran and the US

bullets.text: Trump says he had a very good talk with Netanyahu about Iran as he weighs a return to all-out war after the midterms
bullets.note: Gulf allies fear US bases could make them targets if fighting resumes

bullets.text: Iran's President Masoud Pezeshkian says Iran will not surrender to US threats of war but will try to resolve the problem through dialogue
bullets.note: Tehran is pairing defiance with an opening for talks

bullets.text: Iran's navy says a commercial vessel hit a sea mine and caught fire east of the Strait of Hormuz
bullets.note: Iran's IRGC said two tankers exploded after hitting mines in the strait on Sunday

bullets.text: Russia resumes strikes on Kherson after the end of a local ceasefire, the longest truce of the war, Kyiv says
bullets.note: The truce had been watched as a possible path to wider de-escalation

bullets.text: NATO steps up surveillance of the Black Sea after civilian ships were attacked near Romania and Bulgaria
bullets.note: Concern is growing that Russia's war in Ukraine is spilling over

bullets.text: Grocery stores in at least seven European countries say a cyberattack sent their refrigerator temperatures soaring
bullets.note: It resembles an attack on French stores three weeks ago

bullets.text: Israel's Arab parties, with a record 19 seats, are set to back opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot's bloc
bullets.note: It is another blow to Netanyahu's hopes of forming a government

bullets.text: Israeli troops withdraw from Hebron after a 10-day lockdown and displaced Palestinians return to a damaged quarter
bullets.note: Al Jazeera reports Israeli forces kept up operations elsewhere in the West Bank

bullets.text: At least seven migrants die aboard a boat carrying 139 people to the Canary Islands after a storm
bullets.note: The deaths came after a storm hit the boat on its way to Spain's Canary Islands

bullets.text: Britain's home secretary scraps a plan to make migrant care workers already in the UK wait 15 years for permanent settlement
bullets.note: The reversal affects workers in Britain's social care sector

bullets.text: South Africa and Rwanda lose eligibility for AGOA, the preferential US trade pact
bullets.note: Pretoria had lobbied hard to keep its access to the deal

recaps.title: Market open
recaps.intro: Stocks opened higher as oil fell sharply on signs of US-Iran talks and AI shares rebounded on the Marvell-Lumentum deal. Apple reports after the close, ahead of Tuesday's midterms and Friday's jobs report.
recaps.label: From posts on X

bullets.text: US stocks open higher: S&P 500 up 0.5%, Nasdaq up 0.7%, Dow up 405 points
bullets.note: CNBC says oil's slide and a tech rebound lifted stocks after a losing October for the S&P 500 and Nasdaq.

bullets.text: Iran's supreme leader has granted the government authority for talks, IRNA reports
bullets.note: Oil extended its drop after the report; CNBC had Brent down more than 6% near 106 dollars and WTI near 97 dollars.

bullets.text: Iranian state media says an oil tanker caught fire after hitting a mine in the eastern Strait of Hormuz
bullets.note: Iran's foreign minister said the strait will reopen if the US accepts Tehran's conditions, per IRNA.

bullets.text: Marvell agrees to buy data centre component maker Lumentum in a 115 billion dollar deal
bullets.note: The FT calls it a major bet on the durability of the AI boom; CNBC says the deal lifted sentiment around tech.

bullets.text: Oracle shares fall 4.9% after it announces plans to raise 20 billion dollars through bond and stock sales
bullets.note: Oracle filed to offer 10 billion dollars of common stock and launched a 10 billion dollar bond offering; Moody's affirmed its rating with a negative outlook.

bullets.text: US final October manufacturing PMI comes in at 54.9, below the 56.0 flash reading
bullets.note: The S&P Global survey is the first US data of the week, which ends with Friday's jobs report.

bullets.text: Estee Lauder beats on quarterly earnings and sales and raises its full-year outlook
bullets.note: Adjusted EPS was 72 cents against a 51 cent estimate; it now sees full-year sales up 5% to 6.5%.

bullets.text: Apple reports results after the bell, the first earnings test for new CEO Ternus
bullets.note: Reuters says surging memory costs are in focus as tech stocks try to recover from October's selloff.

bullets.text: Spot gold rises nearly 2% to about 3,950 dollars an ounce
bullets.note: Spot silver also rose more than 3% to above 50 dollars an ounce this morning.

bullets.text: US Strategic Petroleum Reserve falls to 282.2 million barrels, its lowest level since 1982
bullets.note: The reserve is the US government's emergency crude stockpile.

recaps.title: Morning briefing
recaps.intro: The final day before the midterms opens with Trump wrapping up his rally blitz and fallout from a Michigan Democrat backing the Republican, while Iran talks in Doha stall overnight.
recaps.label: From posts on X

bullets.text: Iranian officials leave talks in Doha as a draft proposal for a deal with the US circulates, an official says
bullets.note: The Doha talks concern a possible deal between the US and Iran

bullets.text: Iran warns any act of aggression against it will be met with a powerful, immediate and comprehensive response
bullets.note: Iran foreign ministry spokesperson Esmail Baqaei spoke at a Monday press conference

bullets.text: China's Xi says the Middle East should not become a battleground for great power rivalry
bullets.note: Beijing is pressing for dialogue as the region's conflict drags on

bullets.text: The US backs resuming Russian gas sales to Europe through Ukraine, despite European opposition
bullets.note: A WSJ exclusive; Europe has spent years trying to end its dependence on Moscow

bullets.text: Ukraine says Russia used the Oleshky ceasefire to reinforce its positions
bullets.note: The rare humanitarian truce in the Kherson region ended over the weekend

bullets.text: Trump holds the final rally of his last midterm campaign as president, after 28 rallies since Oct. 1
bullets.note: Republicans are trying to keep their slim majorities in Congress in Tuesday's vote

bullets.text: Trump calls Michigan Republican Mike Rogers "apple pie" and welcomes Rep. Haley Stevens to join the GOP
bullets.note: Stevens stunned Democrats by endorsing Rogers over Democrat Abdul El-Sayed in the Senate race

bullets.text: Ken Paxton's campaign drops its planned Election Day eve event at the Alamo
bullets.note: Paxton is Texas' Republican nominee for the US Senate

bullets.text: Four people are killed in three apparently unrelated shootings in Dallas' Deep Ellum on Halloween night
bullets.note: Police say one suspect is in custody and at least one other is being sought

bullets.text: Director Michael Mann is hospitalized after an accidental gun discharge at a Los Angeles gun range
bullets.note: Mann directed the film Heat

bullets.text: Juan Atkins, who helped create techno music in suburban Detroit in the 1980s, dies at 64
bullets.note: His booking agency announced the death on Sunday

bullets.text: Jerry Koosman, the Miracle Mets lefty who got the final out of the 1969 World Series, dies at 83
bullets.note: The Mets' 1969 title over Baltimore was one of the sport's most shocking

bullets.text: Former Philippine president Rodrigo Duterte attends a hearing at the International Criminal Court
bullets.note: The hearing is part of the ICC case against him

bullets.text: Thick smog blankets New Delhi as air quality is rated very poor, prompting limits on older vehicles
bullets.note: Authorities are stepping up anti-pollution measures in the Indian capital

recaps.title: AI & tech
recaps.intro: OpenAI's Gulf deals lead the AI news as Sam Altman tours Asia and the Middle East, while Anthropic lines up IPO money and Apple faces its first earnings under a new CEO.
recaps.label: From posts on X

bullets.text: OpenAI signs deals to deploy its technology across energy companies, investment firms and government agencies in the UAE
bullets.note: Abu Dhabi's ADNOC and G42 are among the partners as OpenAI seeks funding from state-backed investors

bullets.text: Sam Altman makes a surprise visit to South Korea as OpenAI builds on its chip partnerships
bullets.note: OpenAI is building on its chip partnerships in the country

bullets.text: Anthropic aims to raise up to 3.5 billion dollars from Japanese investors in its US IPO
bullets.note: The planned initial public offering is in the US

bullets.text: OpenAI and Anthropic say their AI models have disproven the Exponential Time Hypothesis
bullets.note: The claimed theoretical result could reshape how researchers assess encryption security

bullets.text: SemiAnalysis releases GDPx, a benchmark of agentic AI work in valuable fields, where the best model scores just 12 percent
bullets.note: Each domain was built with specialized data partners to test real economic tasks

bullets.text: Alphabet offers euro bonds for the second time this year to help fund AI spending
bullets.note: Hyperscalers are increasingly borrowing to pay for data centers

bullets.text: Apple's new CEO Ternus faces his first earnings test as memory costs surge
bullets.note: Apple reports after the bell Monday as tech stocks try to recover from a rough October

bullets.text: The global AI sell-off eases after the Nasdaq's worst month in over a year
bullets.note: Investors are weighing whether AI spending can hold up

bullets.text: Asia's factory activity feels the fading glimmer of the AI boom
bullets.note: Reuters says the AI lift to regional factories is fading

bullets.text: South Korea targets the world’s highest-performing sovereign AI model in a record new budget
bullets.note: President Lee vows bold AI investment

bullets.text: North Korean hackers accused of the largest-ever crypto heist now use AI as a new tool
bullets.note: Bloomberg reports the money helps fund Kim Jong Un’s military expansion

bullets.text: HSBC will open a Hong Kong AI Institute following its Singapore launch
bullets.note: Big banks are building in-house AI centers in Asia

recaps.title: Sports
recaps.intro: Luka Doncic put up a stat line the NBA had never seen, Lamar Jackson is headed for thumb surgery, the last NFL unbeaten fell, and the Patriots won at Miami.
recaps.label: From posts on X

bullets.text: Luka Doncic scores 45 with 15 rebounds, 6 assists, 5 steals and 8 threes, a combination never seen in NBA history, as the Lakers win
bullets.note: The Lakers beat Toronto at home and move to 5-2

bullets.text: Warriors rookie Yaxel Lendeborg scores a career-high 37, the most by a Warriors rookie since Stephen Curry in 2010
bullets.note: Golden State wins its fourth straight

bullets.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson needs thumb surgery and goes on injured reserve
bullets.note: Coach Jesse Minter said the injury is potentially season-ending, and backup Tyler Huntley hurt his toe

bullets.text: The Broncos beat the Chiefs 28-24 after a false start wipes out a would-be winning Patrick Mahomes touchdown
bullets.note: Denver also made a goal-line stand to clinch the AFC West win

bullets.text: The Lions beat the Vikings 19-15, leaving the NFL with no unbeaten teams after eight weeks
bullets.note: The loss also snaps Minnesota's 11-game regular-season winning streak

bullets.text: The Commanders beat the Eagles on Sunday night, handing Philadelphia its sixth straight loss
bullets.note: The Commanders won big at home

bullets.text: The Patriots come back in the second half to win at Miami and improve to 5-3
bullets.note: New England gets back in the win column

bullets.text: The Buccaneers beat the Falcons without completing a pass, running 56 times in a downpour
bullets.note: Tampa Bay attempted just three passes all game

bullets.text: The Kraken trade Shane Wright to the Predators for Matthew Wood in a one-for-one swap of former first-round picks
bullets.note: Elliotte Friedman first reported the teams were working on a deal

bullets.text: Connor McDavid reaches 30 assists faster than any player in NHL history
bullets.note: The Oilers improved to 7-0-0 on the road

bullets.text: Cutter Gauthier scores twice in 36 seconds to finish a hat trick as the Ducks complete a comeback
bullets.note: Goalie Laurent Brossoit, in his first game with Anaheim, earned his first win since April 2024

bullets.text: Alexander Zverev is officially world No. 1 in the ATP rankings
bullets.note: He is the 30th player to reach No. 1

bullets.text: Lorenzo Musetti beats Hubert Hurkacz 7-6(3), 7-6(10) in Paris to set up a match with top seed Zverev
bullets.note: Zverev is the top seed in Paris

bullets.text: Wilyer Abreu wins a third straight Gold Glove, and Ceddanne Rafaela and Caleb Durbin also win for the Red Sox
bullets.note: Durbin is the first Red Sox third baseman to win one since Frank Malzone in 1959, per Chris Cotillo

bullets.text: Florida State fires coach Mike Norvell hours after a home loss to Clemson, despite a buyout of about 50 million dollars
bullets.note: The buyout is among the largest in college football history

recaps.title: Vermont on X
recaps.intro: A quiet news day in Vermont, with an unusually mild start to the week, a dry October in the books and light showers possible in the north on Election Day.
recaps.label: From posts on X

bullets.text: Temperatures were in the mid 50s across the Champlain and St. Lawrence valleys early Monday, the biggest 24-hour change in the country
bullets.note: A sharp swing from a cold Sunday morning

bullets.text: Monday brings partly sunny skies with highs in the upper 50s to low 60s, and light showers are possible in the north on Election Day
bullets.note: Any rain on Tuesday is expected to be light

bullets.text: October ended with near-normal temperatures but below-normal rain, as much as 30 to 45 percent short in southeastern Vermont
bullets.note: Aside from a brief cold, wet stretch mid-month, the month was uneventful

bullets.text: November is likely to run warmer than normal, helped by a warm first week, the weather service says
bullets.note: Precipitation odds are even, with changeable patterns expected

bullets.text: Fire danger was high across most of Vermont on Sunday, though short of red flag status, with beneficial showers due Thursday
bullets.note: Dry conditions are worth watching this week

bullets.text: Rutland County will get a walk-in urgent care for mental health conditions in 2027
bullets.note: It will give residents a place to get help fast

bullets.text: Folk and banjo player Bow Thayer celebrates his new album 'Ninevah' with a release party at Burlington's SEABA Center
bullets.note: Seven Days photographed the show
